There no external or internal injuries on the body of the complainant.

opennyai_summary.18_August_2023__decision:
Appellant is in jail for more than 3 years.

it is prayed that remaining jail sentence of appellant may be suspended and he be released on bail.

Heard and perused the record.
opennyai_summary.15_February_2024__facts:
This is first bail application filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of bail during trial relating to Crime No.122/2022 dated (not mentioned), registered at Police Station-Sardarpur, District-Dhar, for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376, 506 of IPC, 1860 and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act 2012.
The applicant i s in custody since 14.12.2023.
2. As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is of commission of rape upon the prosecutrix.
opennyai_summary.15_February_2024__arguments:
The applicant and prosecutrix have resided one week with each other.
MLC report has not been corroborated with the Anil vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145048491/
1 prosecution case.
opennyai_summary.15_February_2024__decision:
The applicant is in custody since 14.12.2023 i.e. more than two months.
Conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
6 . Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, the rival submissions of the counsel for the parties and custody period of the applicant, without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.
7. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his/her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his/her presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.
It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
8.
This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
Certified Copy as per rules.

opennyai_summary.7_August_2025__facts:
2. The applicant is in jail since 22.6.2025 in connection with Crime No.306 of 2024 registered at P.S. Amanganj, District- Panna for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 343, 376(2) (n)

opennyai_summary.7_August_2025__arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is in jail since 22.6.2025.
opennyai_summary.7_August_2025__decision:
No custodial interrogation is required.
On above grounds, it is urged that applicant be released on bail.
Looking to overall facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.
7. opennyai_summary.final__PREAMBLE:
Anil vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 24 March, 2026
Author: Vijay Kumar Shukla
Bench: Vijay Kumar Shukla
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
 Cra No. 292 of 2024
 (Anil Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh )
 Dated : 24-03-2026
opennyai_summary.final__facts:
The present appellant has been convicted for commission of offences punishable under Section 363,
366(A), 376(2), 376(2)(N) of the Indian Penal Code & Section 5(L)/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act and sentenced to undergo 7, 10, 10, 10, 20 years' rigorous imprisonment along with fine of Rs.1000/- for each sections respectively with default stipulations.
During dancing at about 12:00 am two persons came with motorcycle and they caught hold of the prosecutrix and went to Maharashtra by motorcycle and she lived with 2 CRA-292-2024 appellant for two days in the huts.
In this period appellant has committed rape with the prosecutrix.
On 25.03.2019 prosecutrix has been recovered from the possession of the present appellant.
opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS:
Anil vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 24 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91763228/
1
Upon going through the statement of prosecutrix, we find that the prosecution has not placed any birth certificate on record.
The age is found to be proved by the trial Court on the basis of the scholar register, where the source for recording the age of the prosecutrix has not been proved.
Apart from that, the appellant was 21 years of age at the time of the incident; the prosecutrix herself had gone on the bike alongwith the appellant and another person.
In the case of Tejubai v/s The State of Madhya Pradesh reported in 2025 (1) MPLJ (Crl.) 75, it has been held that if the date of birth of the prosecutrix in the school 3 CRA-292-2024 register is recorded on the basis of a person who made entry of the date of birth, the same is not sufficient to prove the age.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
This is an appeal of 2024, and final hearing of the same will take time.
Considering the same, we deem it appropriate to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the present appellant.
Accordingly, I.A. No.9637/2025 stands allowed.
The execution of remaining jail sentence of appellant - Anil Solanki shall remain suspended during the pendency of the appeal and he be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court and on depositing the fine amount (if not already deposited) with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 10.08.2026 , and thereafter, on all subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard during the pendency of the appeal.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
